'''Skar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. After his time at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Korriban Academy]], Lord Skar was [[Darth Thanaton]]'s apprentice.

==Biography==
During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]] Thanaton removed the commander of the [[115th]] stationed at the [[Islands Outpost]] and had Skar replace him. After Thanaton's rival [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] defeated Skar as part of the [[Kaggath]], Skar agreed to tell Thanaton's plan. He then informed his Master's rival that Thanaton intended to destroy the fuel refinery for Kallig's fleet. When Thanaton fled a duel with Kallig in presence of multiple Sith and Imperials, Skar informed Kallig that Thanaton was headed for [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] to enlist the assistance of the [[Dark Council]].<ref name="TOR" />
